campaign.title: Rename G40_01_PROVIDER while preserving identity and bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_01_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_01_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_01_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 84) THEN
    G40_01_PROVIDER = 84
  END IF
  G40_01_PROVIDER = G40_01_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_01_PRED_1(X)
  G40_01_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_01_PROVIDER(X) >= 64) THEN
    G40_01_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_01_PRED_1 = G40_01_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
